tasks.notes: plan-defect: `evals/frontier/README.md:5` says the untracked set includes "the eighty-one `results/` readings". The 81 tracked paths under `evals/frontier/results/` that this patch deletes include `evals/frontier/results/.gitkeep`, which is a directory placeholder, not a reading — so the count of actual readings is 80. The figure is transcribed faithfully from the task's own Context ("`results/` is 81 readings from 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-31"), so the defect is the plan's text, not the implementation; the M3 pin does not test the number and nothing else depends on it. Fix, if wanted, is a one-word edit inside this task's FILES (`evals/frontier/README.md`): "the eighty-one `results/` readings" → "the `results/` readings".

unverified: the new CLAUDE.md sentence asserts two facts this patch cannot establish — that `.gitignore` carries the ignore rule for `evals/frontier/corpus/` and `evals/frontier/results/`, and that `evals/frontier/README.md` is a tracked stub. Both are produced by sibling Task 1 (FILES `.gitignore`, `evals/frontier/README.md`), not by this diff. This task's own Proof correctly does not test them, and the task Context explicitly says "this task does not read the stub or depend on its content", so nothing here is wrong — but the sentence is only true once Task 1's patch lands in the same weave. What would settle it: Task 1's exam (`grep -c '^evals/frontier/corpus/$' .gitignore`, `grep -c '^evals/frontier/results/$' .gitignore`, and `git ls-files evals/frontier` listing `evals/frontier/README.md`) passing on the folded tree.; The three added lines in CLAUDE.md:65-67 run ~155 characters each, against the ~95-column wrap of every surrounding bullet in `## Layout` (the precedent `docs/superpowers/` bullet at lines 51–56 wraps at that width). This is forced by the plan, not chosen by the implementer: the prescribed sentence is ~380 characters and the Proof's third `Run:` bounds the diff to at most 3 added lines (`$1 <= 3`), so wrapping at the file's own width would need ~5 added lines and fail the exam. No edit inside CLAUDE.md can satisfy both, which is why the actor is `plan`. If the wrap matters, the fix is to the task's numstat bound (raise `$1 <= 3` to `$1 <= 6`), after which the sentence can be rewrapped to column 95 with no change to its wording or to any other bullet.
